lines.2: 「That's right. It would be nice to go have some fun together once in a while.」
lines.3: Otome brought it up during dinner.
lines.4: Hakkeijima, by the way, was an amusement park with an aquarium.
lines.5: It was quite large and popular with young people.
lines.6: An amusement park with Otome, huh...
lines.9: I wondered what had gotten into her.
